SELECT l.id, l.operate_user_id, l.description, l.class_name, l.method_name, l.method_params, l.return_value, l.cost_time, l.operate_time, u.name AS operate_user_name FROM operate_log l LEFT JOIN user u ON l.operate_user_id = u.id
AND (l.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY l.id DESC
